def to_number(value):
    """Convert Excel-like cell contents to a number when possible; otherwise return None."""
    if value is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return None
    if isinstance(value, (int, float, Decimal)):
        return float(value)
    if isinstance(value, str):
        s = value.strip()
        if not s:
            return None
        # handle simple numeric strings, optionally with commas
        s = s.replace(',', '')
        try:
            return float(s)
        except ValueError:
            return None

        n_value = to_number(n_cell.value)

        excess_rounded = round(excess, 10)
        if abs(excess_rounded - int(excess_rounded)) < 1e-10:
            o_cell.value = int(excess_rounded)
        else:
            o_cell.value = excess_rounded

wb.save(output_path)

# Verification printout of the modified answer range.
